description: Pinned, sha-verified compiler toolchains that run INSIDE a wasm sandbox (wasmtime) and compile untrusted source with zero native execution. Recipes are canonical in runtime/compilers/<lang>/; this registry is the index + pins. `vendor.sh` assembles a standalone copy.

toolchains.name: c4
toolchains.notes: No-LLVM C-SUBSET compiler+interpreter. Compiles AND runs untrusted C in one wasm process. Built with `zig cc -target wasm32-wasi`. Subset only (no full C99); for full C use the clang toolchain.

toolchains.name: clang
toolchains.notes: Full C/C++ clang+lld as a wasm32-wasi module (imports ONLY wasi_snapshot_preview1). Two in-sandbox stages: `clang -c` then `wasm-ld` (the driver can't fork under WASI). Also the backend that finishes the Zig lane.

toolchains.name: zig1+clang
toolchains.notes: zig1.wasm (bootstrap, C-backend-only) compiles .zig -> C in-sandbox; the clang toolchain compiles+links that C -> wasm. End-to-end zero native execution. Direct .zig->wasm in-sandbox blocked upstream (ziglang/zig#20665).

toolchains.name: rustc
toolchains.summary: rustc->wasm32-wasi is an open upstream frontier (rust-lang/rust#62202, internals#16198): rustc embeds LLVM as a library, forks a proc-macro server + linker (impossible under WASI), needs realpath/threads. No prebuilt rustc.wasm exists. cg_clif emits native (no wasm output). mrustc (Rust->C) has no wasm build + only Rust ~1.54.
toolchains.unblock_when: an upstream/community wasm32-wasi rustc ships (a la YoWASP clang), OR LLVM-for-wasi (RFC #79073) matures + in-process proc-macro/linker + WASI realpath/threads.
